report:
DebeziumException: The db history topic is missing

Hi
I'm on the oracle-debezium connection with debezium running in a kafka-connect configuration.
Since a couple of weeks ago, when I changed the used debezium task connection properties to remove schema structure from event payload generation I'm encountering this error:
"trace": "io.debezium.DebeziumException: The db history topic is missing. You may attempt to recover it by reconfiguring the connector to SCHEMA_ONLY_RECOVERY
	at io.debezium.connector.oracle.OracleConnectorTask.validateAndLoadSchemaHistory(OracleConnectorTask.java:252)
	at io.debezium.connector.oracle.OracleConnectorTask.start(OracleConnectorTask.java:96)
	at io.debezium.connector.common.BaseSourceTask.start(BaseSourceTask.java:141)
	at org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.AbstractWorkerSourceTask.initializeAndStart(AbstractWorkerSourceTask.java:280)
	at org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.WorkerTask.doRun(WorkerTask.java:202)
	at org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.WorkerTask.run(WorkerTask.java:259)
	at org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.AbstractWorkerSourceTask.run(AbstractWorkerSourceTask.java:77)
	at org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.isolation.Plugins.lambda$withClassLoader$1(Plugins.java:236)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.Executors$RunnableAdapter.call(Executors.java:539)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.FutureTask.run(FutureTask.java:264)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1136)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:635)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:840)
"
The strange fact here is that my snapshot mode is already configured on snapshot mode SCHEMA_ONLY_RECOVERY and I do have a schema internal topic configured.
As I said I'm encountering this error later then having applied these properties to the connection:
"key.converter": "org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConverter"",
"value.converter": "org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConverter",
"key.converter.schemas.enable": "false",
"value.converter.schemas.enable": "false"

evidence.quote: I think I covered this on Zulip, the issue as I understand was the lack of infinite retention.

notes: Reporter blamed a converter change; the history topic lacked infinite retention and was purged by Kafka. Schema history validation on task start settles it.
